analysis:
Examined all metadata, patches and source excerpts. This batch contains documentation, not executable implementations; no concrete security regression is established. No changes to authorization, attestation, credentials, billing or hop encryption are shown.
Integration must verify these documented contracts: changelog.d/glm-startup-single-verification.md:3-4 replaces repeated hashing with managed-load verification and a persisted identity-keyed hash. Under ADV-001/TB-003, owner-only storage alone cannot authenticate this record against the operator. Check manifest binding, record validation, file-race handling and verification before publication/serving (A-004, T-012, T-027), including verified-weight cache bindings in T-041; record forgery or a verification bypass is not demonstrated here.
changelog.d/glm-openrouter-returned-reasoning.md:3-7 and glm-openrouter-structured-output-and-tool-choice.md:3-5 describe expanded input acceptance and post-generation validation. Verify schema limits, withholding of invalid answer/tool bytes, explicit reasoning-stream semantics, prompt-contract/cache-scope updates and encrypted relay behavior (A-001, T-008, T-041). Their forced-tool-choice statements conflict and need reconciliation, not a vulnerability finding.
changelog.d/glm-variable-frame-rate-video.md:3 expands media acceptance; check finite frame-rate handling, decode/frame resource bounds, cancellation and preservation of protected plaintext storage (TB-007, T-010, T-050). native-engine-output-control-refusal.md:3-4 describes bounded logprobs and early typed errors intended to prevent cooldown abuse; verify reservation and error mapping.
page-cache-counts-as-available-memory.md:3-5 and docs/architecture/hardware-support.md head:256-262 broaden available-memory accounting across admission and KV grants. Check counter overlap, saturation, live samples and ledger clamps. Hardware-support head:226-233 and glm-wired-limit-notice.md:3-5 describe advisory-only privileged settings, not automatic elevation. Runtime sources are needed to resolve these security-relevant contracts; unchanged surrounding memory controls were not independently verified.
